summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing same-day buybacks of its own shares, the Argentine equivalent of an issuer repurchase program report. CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$2,067.05 for AR$248,046,981, while wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. bought 30,000 ADRs (300,000 underlying shares) on the NYSE at an average US$12.82 for US$384,744.97, both settling around October 19, 2026. The dual-market purchases, executed under Capital Markets Law No. 26,831 Article 64, stayed under 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily volume; no board recommendation or advisor is cited. Watch for continuation of the repurchase program and ADR/ordinary parity as accumulation proceeds.
